'''''Visseon II''''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It participated in an [[Ambush in the Laramus system|ambush]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy in the [[Laramus system/Legends|Laramus system]].<ref name="Laramus" />
